description: The line plot illustrates the proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency, comparing different configurations of the model on two platforms, FigStep and MMSafetyBench. The x-axis represents the number of steps, with values 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis measures the harmful with refusal ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different configuration: LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue line with circle markers), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange line with square markers), LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green line with triangle markers), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red line with diamond markers). The lines show varying trends, with the red line (Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench) generally having the highest refusal ratio, especially at 1024 steps.
